officialLine: Private AI that works with your files. What happens on your computer stays on your computer.
officialLineShort: Private AI that works with your files.

locale.heading: Language
locale.help: The language for menus and the rest of Larra. System follows this computer's language.
locale.helpUsing: The language for menus and the rest of Larra. Currently using %{language}.

settings.title: Settings
settings.textSizeHelp: Default is the original size. Large and Larger make the text in this window bigger.
settings.textSizeKeysWin: Ctrl+ and Ctrl- change the size.
settings.houseRulesHelp: How the AI should answer: tone, language, what never to promise. Set this once. Larra follows it in every conversation and Recipe.
settings.houseRulesPlaceholder:
Examples:
· Answer in the language of the documents unless asked otherwise.
· We are a furniture workshop. Use first names.
· Never promise delivery dates; say the team will confirm.
settings.onlineHelp: Let Chat research the public web. Each query or address is shown for your approval before it is sent. Answers are written on this computer.
settings.keepUsingChat: You can keep using Chat while this finishes.
settings.otherAisLede: More options that work with this computer's memory.
settings.suggestedLede: Chosen to work with this computer's memory.
settings.exploreLede: Browse public catalogs for something else. Only the search words leave this computer.
settings.resetHelp: Deletes conversations, settings, House rules, Recipes, what Larra has read, and the AI. Your own files stay on disk. Larra forgets the Shelves that pointed at them.
settings.dataFolderHint: The data folder path is local to this computer. Do not paste it into a public issue.
settings.logOnDisk: Log contents stay on disk (they can name local files).
settings.measureFailed: Could not measure speed. Try again when Chat is idle.

onboarding.lede:
Larra is a private AI that works with your files.
What happens on your computer stays on your computer.
onboarding.cardChatBody: Talk to your personal AI: brainstorm ideas, ask questions, or put it to work on your files.
onboarding.cardShelfBody: A Shelf can be a project, a client, or an idea. Create it, attach a folder, and start working on it.
onboarding.cardRecipesBody: Recipes are tasks you can reuse across Shelves and Chats, so you don't start from scratch every time.
onboarding.installLede: This AI will answer on this computer. Installation can take a few minutes.
onboarding.verifyingNote: Checking that the file downloaded correctly.
onboarding.installingNote: Larra will be ready when it finishes.
onboarding.severalFree: There are several free AIs. Larra picked one that should run well here.

chat.dropHint: Drop files to use them in this conversation
chat.deleteConversation: Delete this conversation? This cannot be undone.
chat.installFirstBody: Chat needs one on this computer before it can answer.
chat.startBody: Ask a question. Choose a Shelf when the answer should come from your files.
chat.chooseShelfForRecipes: Choose a Shelf to see Recipes that use your files.
chat.needsAi: To start using Larra you need to download an AI.
chat.filesOnShelfAndConversation: Files on this Shelf and in this conversation
chat.interrupted: The answer was interrupted. Your question and any partial answer are saved.
chat.continuePrompt: Continue the previous answer from the last sentence. Do not repeat.
chat.answerComplete: Answer ready. Review the answer and its sources.
chat.queryLeaves: This exact query will be sent to Wikipedia, DuckDuckGo and You.com. Check that it contains no private information.
chat.urlLeaves: Larra will contact the website to open this address. Check that the full address contains no private information.

shelves.title: Shelves
shelves.lede: Add files you want to ask about. In Chat, choose a Shelf when the answer should come from them.
shelves.namePlaceholder: Shelf name, like Projects or Research
shelves.emptyTitle: You don't have a Shelf yet
shelves.emptyBody: A Shelf brings together files for Chat to use. Create one, add files or link a folder you already use, then choose it in Chat.
shelves.dropToAdd: Drop files to add them to %{name}
shelves.syncFolderHint: Link a folder on this computer. New files in it show up here.
shelves.dropToFill: Drop files to add them to this Shelf
shelves.dropTypes: PDFs, Office documents, spreadsheets, presentations, and email. Larra reads them on this computer.
shelves.removeFolder:
Remove “%{name}” from this Shelf?

This won't delete any files from your computer. Larra will stop using this folder.
shelves.deleteShelfConfirm:
Delete “%{name}”?

shelves.lookThrough: How Chat looks through this Shelf
shelves.tryDifferentFilter: Try a different name, source, or type.
shelves.folderMissing: This folder isn't here right now. Files stay on the Shelf.

shelves.removeSyncedHint: Remove from this Shelf (files stay on disk)

documents.currentContext: Surrounding text in the current file
documents.sourceUnverified: The saved passage could not be located in the current file.

recipes.title: Recipes
recipes.lede: Saved prompts. Open one to start a new conversation with the prompt ready to send.
recipes.name: Recipe name
recipes.promptPlaceholder:
The prompt this Recipe starts with. Use «angle quotes» for the bits that change each time, e.g.
Summarize what changed for «client name» this month and draft a short update email.
recipes.emptyBody: Save a question you will ask again. You can reuse it on any Shelf.
recipes.resetConfirm: Reset this Recipe to its original name and prompt?

reply-to-client.name: Reply to a client
reply-to-client.prompt:
Draft a reply to this client message in your usual voice. Keep it warm and concrete, end with a clear next step, and write it in the client's language.

Client message:
«paste the message here»

one-page-brief.name: One-page brief
one-page-brief.prompt: Give me a one-page brief of «document name» from this Shelf: what it is, the key points, exact dates and amounts, and any risks or open questions.

compare-documents.name: Compare two documents
compare-documents.prompt: Compare «document A» and «document B» from this Shelf. Start with a two-sentence verdict, then list the differences that matter (payment, dates, obligations, prices, termination) and finish with what we should double-check.

document-key-terms.name: Document key terms
document-key-terms.prompt: List the key terms of «document name» from this Shelf as a table: term, what it says, the exact date or amount, and where it says so.

minutes-actions.name: Minutes → action list
minutes-actions.prompt:
Turn these meeting notes into an action list with an owner and a deadline for each item, then note any open questions.

Notes:
«paste the notes here»

translate.name: Translate this
translate.prompt:
Translate the text below into «language», keeping the structure and keeping names, numbers, and legal references exact.

«paste the text here»

policy-qa.name: Policy Q&A
policy-qa.prompt: What do our documents on this Shelf say about «topic»? Answer only from those documents and cite where it says so. If it isn't covered, tell me plainly.

campaign-ideas.name: Five campaign ideas
campaign-ideas.prompt: Give me five ideas for «campaign, product or promotion». For each one give me a hook, the channel it fits best, and an example first line.
